Sir/ Madam,
Sub: Intimation reg. registration for sale of 92.258 acres of Land at Rasayani to BPCL
Ref: Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Govt. of India Letter No.P-51015/12/2017-Ch III
dated 09.10.2018
The Ministry of Chemicals & Fertilizers, Government of India vide its letter referred above
communicated the decision of Government for the sale of 242 acres of land at Rasayani to
BPCL as part of restructuring of HOCL. Subsequently, necessary approval from
shareholders for the sale of said 242 acres of land was also obtained. In accordance with
the decision of the Government of India and the approval accorded by the shareholders’,
the registration for sale of Land parcels comprising 92.258 in favour of BPCL was
completed this evening for a sale consideration of Rs.166.14 Cr. (approx.) TDS as
applicable will also be deducted from the sale proceeds.
Submitted for kind information.
Thanking you.
Yours faithfully,
For Hindustan Organic Chemicals Limited
Subramonian H
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer
